#### 1. palmoplantar keratoderma-sclerodactyly syndrome  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.737)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:18398)

Loss-of-function mutations in SMARCAD1 impair its role in transcription regulation, which in turn disrupts keratinocyte differentiation. **How to falsify it:** Identification of pathogenic loss-of-function variants in SMARCAD1 in individuals with palmoplantar keratoderma-sclerodactyly syndrome who do not exhibit the full spectrum of features seen in absence of fingerprints-congenital milia syndrome, or vice versa, would suggest distinct downstream effects or modifier genes. _(variant: None)_
